definition.en: How much surface a shape covers, counted in unit squares of one size.
definition.zh: 一个图形盖住的面有多大，用一样大的单位正方形去数。

definition.en: The distance all the way round the edge of a shape.
definition.zh: 沿图形的边走一圈的长度。

definition.en: The area of one unit square: the unit for counting area on a grid.
definition.zh: 一个单位正方形的面积；在方格上数面积用的单位。

definition.en: The area of a square with sides of 1 cm.
definition.zh: 边长 1 cm 的正方形的面积。

definition.en: The area of a square with sides of 1 m: for floors and walls.
definition.zh: 边长 1 m 的正方形的面积；用来量地面、墙面。

definition.en: A square whose sides are 1 unit long.
definition.zh: 边长是 1 个单位的正方形。

definition.en: The longer side of a rectangle is its length, the shorter side its breadth. Area = length × breadth.
definition.zh: 长方形较长的边叫长，较短的边叫宽。面积 = 长 × 宽。

definition.en: One straight edge of a figure. A square's four sides are equal; its side is the length of one of them.
definition.zh: 图形的一条直边。正方形四条边一样长，一条边的长度叫边长。

definition.en: A four-sided figure with four square corners and opposite sides equal.
definition.zh: 四个角都是直角、对边一样长的四边形。

definition.en: A four-sided figure with four equal sides and four square corners.
definition.zh: 四条边一样长、四个角都是直角的四边形。

definition.en: A figure whose sides are all straight and meet at square corners, like an L shape.
definition.zh: 边都是直线、角都是直角的图形，比如 L 形。

definition.en: A figure made of rectangles and squares put together.
definition.zh: 由几个长方形、正方形拼成的图形。

definition.en: The lengths in the picture only show the idea; work with the numbers marked.
definition.zh: 图上的长短只是示意，要用标出的数来算。

definition.en: Paper or a picture covered with equal squares, used to count area and perimeter.
definition.zh: 画满一样大正方形的纸或图，用来数面积和周长。
